# Historical workflow configuration

`audio8d-release.yml` belonged to the former `8D/` application in this examples repository. That directory is no longer present; Audio8D now lives in the [8D audio converter repository](https://github.com/gcfernando/8d-audio-converter).

The original workflow is retained byte-for-byte here for reference. GitHub only discovers workflows directly under `.github/workflows/`, so this archived configuration cannot be dispatched or triggered by a tag. Review the current Audio8D packaging guide before creating any replacement release workflow.
